title_en: Artificial Intelligence (8/20): A Debate on AI Ethics
note_en: 跟不上 "can't keep up with" runs through this whole text: 现在的法律还跟不上人工智能的发展速度 "current laws still can't keep up with the speed of AI development." It's 跟 "follow" plus the potential complement 上 "(reach) up," with 不 inserted for "cannot"; the positive is 跟得上. Note also 越…越… in the last sentence: 技术发展得越快，社会各方就越需要共同努力 "the faster technology develops, the more society needs to work together."
